scripts._comment:build:desktop: The desktop app loads the bundle from disk over file://, where an absolute /assets/... path resolves to the drive root and nothing loads — a white window. --base=./ emits relative paths. Passed on the CLI rather than through an env var because the release runner is Windows, where VITE_BASE=x npm run build is not a thing cmd.exe understands.
scripts.desktop: npm run build:desktop && cd desktop && npm start
scripts.desktop:win: npm run build:desktop && cd desktop && npm run build:win
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:serial && npm run test:raster && npm run test:pos
